item.title: Sotto 0.3.1
item.description:
• Voice notes: while holding ⌥Space, tap N to turn what you're saying into a note. Let go and Sotto keeps listening, hands-free, with Pause and Stop right on the pill; ⌥Space again saves it. Notes are tidied by the on-device model and kept as Markdown files on your Mac. Nothing is typed and nothing touches your clipboard.
  • The orb takes notes: it looks down at a small notepad while you talk.
  • A new Notes pane in Insights, and a Notes item in the menu, to read, copy and move notes to the Trash. A note is never lost if Sotto quits or your Mac sleeps mid-note.
  • The orb ripples the pill whenever it leaves or returns, and pops up from, and drops back into, the bottom of the screen.
  • The Note key can be changed in Settings › General.
